Read `README.md` and current rollout evidence first. Produce exactly one multi-wake target-policy candidate in `solver/`. Keep candidate-specific reasoning in `logs/optimize/wake_policy_notes.md`, and add or materially revise at least one evidence-backed reusable lesson in `guidance/control_experience.md` from the assigned parent, sampled solver results, and inherited logs. If no positive lesson survives the evidence, record a concrete negative result and what later workers should avoid or test. The candidate is incomplete until both files are updated. Work only inside this Phase 2 workspace.

This is the no-Bookshelf ablation: no cross-domain fish-control research shelf
is provided. Base controller proposals only on the task contract, current and
inherited guidance, sampled solver results, inherited optimizer logs, and
current rollout evidence. Do not search for or reconstruct the omitted shelf
from neighboring configurations or repository history.

I’m using the `read-wake-visual-signals-first` skill because this task changes a multi-wake dogfish target policy. I’ll read the workspace contract and the skill instructions completely, then inspect the current rollout keyframes/evidence before touching `solver/`.

The contract confirms the visual-evidence ordering and forbids running CFD here. I’m now anchoring the keyframes to the inherited score, observation, metrics, diagnostics, guidance, and optimizer logs; only after that diagnosis will I write the required notes and change the candidate.

The visual evidence is decisive: the seed briefly moves toward the target, then pitches into an almost vertical downward path and exits after only 50.1 released time units. That matches the large negative y displacement (`-13.30L`), tiny net progress (`0.024`), and high moment/load metrics; the useful mechanism is propulsion, while the missing capability is bounded heading correction from task-relative state. I’m checking the exposed state conventions and actuator schema before specifying that feedback.

The diagnostics sharpen the failure: the seed hit both configured action caps exactly (`260°/time` and `1800°/time²`), while its nominal `Aω` and `Aω²` exceed those caps. Its heading rose from `29°` to about `81°`, lateral target offset reached `9.01L`, and it never entered the developed wake corridor. Per the skill, I’m recording that visual diagnosis and a falsifiable hypothesis in the candidate notes before editing the policy.

The notes now capture the skill-driven diagnosis and hypothesis. The candidate change will keep the policy state-only and target-relative: an actuator-feasible oscillator plus an `8°` bounded curvature bias driven by body-frame bearing and its recent rate. I’m also adding the durable negative lesson that the inherited seed’s apparent propulsion came from a cap-limited regime and should not be intensified.

Both required artifacts are updated, and the solver still contains one non-empty candidate. I’m moving to verification now: inspect the exact diff, run syntax/schema checks, then invoke the mandated check runner and repair anything it flags. No CFD will be launched.

The boundary check passed. Two infrastructure issues surfaced in the mandated runner: the rendered workspace `README.md` repeats the same “copied to guidance” parent marker twice, so the guidance checker refuses to choose a parent; and `julia` is not currently on `PATH`. I’m inspecting the checker and available runtime paths, then I’ll make the narrowest workspace-local repair and rerun all checks.

All three mandated checks now pass after deduplicating the rendered parent marker and using the workspace’s pinned Julia runtime. One final audit caught a prose mismatch—the notes said `22°` while the implemented oscillator scale is `14°`—so I’m correcting that provenance detail and rerunning the checks once more.

Final verification is clean: guidance/notes PASS, policy contract PASS, and solver boundary PASS. I’m doing a last read-only inventory for handoff line references and to confirm no sibling target-policy candidate was created.

Completed exactly one multi-wake candidate.

- [Candidate policy](solver/cases/dogfish_2d_shape_policy/candidate_target_policy.jl:1): cap-feasible oscillator with bounded body-frame bearing/rate steering.
- [Candidate reasoning](logs/optimize/wake_policy_notes.md:3): visual/metric diagnosis and falsifiable hypothesis.
- [Reusable lesson](guidance/control_experience.md:24): records why the saturated seed drive should not be intensified and its falsification boundary.

All mandated checks pass: guidance materiality, Julia policy contract/schema, and solver boundary. I also removed the duplicated assigned-parent marker from the rendered `README.md`, which initially prevented the guidance checker from resolving its parent. No CFD was run.
